en: The postcard features a colorized photograph (or lithograph) of a grand European public square with a large, ornate building at its center, flanked by impressive multi-story buildings in late 19th-century architectural style. There are trees and well-maintained gardens in the foreground and several people scattered around the square. At the top right of the image, it says 'Sundsvall. Vängåfvan.' The reverse side includes handwritten text in Swedish, a green postage stamp, and is addressed to 'Fru Hanny Utter, Utö.'
